689:t_020:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「Here we go! $$真化融合$$!」

689:t_021:0.en:
$n
「Let's do it, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$!」

689:t_021:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「I understand! Now $$マジンガー$$ and I have become one!」

689:t_021:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「It draws power from your steel bodies and strengthens your hearts even further!」

689:t_021:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「Our feelings and power are growing...!」

689:t_021:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's incredible...! Power is overflowing from my machine!」

689:t_021:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Our machines... we... evolved... No, did we attain $$シンカ$$!?」

689:t_021:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$真化融合$$... It looks like it succeeded.」

689:t_021:10.en:
$$エスター$$
「I believed all of you could do it!」

689:t_021:12.en:
$$カトル$$
「You'll fight alongside us too, then.」

689:t_021:13.en:
$$エスター$$
「Of course! I'm part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$... No, $c too!」

689:t_021:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm counting on you to control the $$ソーラリアン$$'s power. I have high hopes for you, $$エスター$$.」

689:t_021:15.en:
$$エスター$$
「Thank you, Chief... For working so hard, all this time, to save me...」

689:t_021:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「Finding a way to understand the unknown and do the impossible is a scientist's nature.」

689:t_021:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm leaving the $$ソーラリアン$$ to you, $$エスター$$!」

689:t_021:18.en:
$$シモン$$
「We can't let ourselves fall behind either!」

689:t_022:1.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Come on, $$シモン$$! We're ready whenever you are!」

689:t_023:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do it, $$グレンラガン$$! Tengen Toppa!!」

689:t_024:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's the one I've heard about...!」

689:t_024:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「That's the one I've heard about...!」

689:t_024:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「That's the one I've heard about...!」

689:t_024:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$!」

689:t_024:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「This $$カオス・コスモス$$ is the same as the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s universe. Will determines the recognition of existence.」

689:t_024:5.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The Spiral Man has now become completely one with the spiral... with his drill. Nothing can stop him anymore.」

689:t_024:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's how it is, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Trying to control our hearts and halt their evolution is useless!」

689:t_024:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「As we promised the $$アンチスパイラル$$, we'll defeat you and protect the universe!」

689:t_024:10.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Please give us your words...!」

689:t_024:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「My will has not changed.」

689:t_024:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Stop them here. Even at the cost of your lives.」

689:t_024:14.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「We will fulfill your expectations without fail!」

689:t_025:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「So he turned tail and ran, the bastard!」

689:t_025:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「It didn't look that way to me, though...」

689:t_025:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is their universe. They can't run or hide anymore.」

689:t_025:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You seem shaken for people blessed with the protection of God's emissary.」

689:t_025:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「We have nothing left to fear!」

689:t_025:7.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll gather all our power and fight you!」

689:t_025:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To forge our future with our own hands!」

689:t_025:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here we come, servants of the $$御使い$$s! Now we're a drill that sweeps everything up as it advances!」

689:t_025:14.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll carry all our friends' feelings and our machines' feelings, and keep moving forward!!」

689:t_026:0.en:
$$凱$$
「I've confirmed that all enemies have been wiped out.」

689:t_026:1.en:
$$渓$$
「All right...! Our first battle is a complete victory!」

689:t_027:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief... Can we return to our world from this $$カオス・コスモス$$?」

689:t_027:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「I wonder... I can't say for sure right now.」

689:t_027:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Can't we at least find out what's happening there? I'd like to know how the battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ ended.」

689:t_027:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Can't we at least find out what's happening there? I'd like to know how the battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ ended.」

689:t_027:4.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Can't we at least find out what's happening there? I'd like to know how the battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ ended.」

689:t_027:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I think we who were there could only come to this universe because the $$時空震動弾$$ activated, but...」

689:t_028:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warriors of Earth. Because of your victory, the $$バアル$$ vanished into the gap between dimensions.」

689:t_028:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Intelligent life will unite its strength and eradicate the remaining $$バアル$$.」

689:t_028:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Correct. Until the $$御使い$$s are defeated, intelligent life will never know peace.」

689:t_028:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$... We share the same goal of defeating the $$御使い$$s.」

689:t_028:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll set aside your attempt to use Earth and its people for now. Will you join forces with us?」

689:t_028:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why!? We're offering even though we're holding back our anger at you!」

689:t_028:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...If you wish to defeat the $$御使い$$s, hand over your four $$スフィア$$s.」

689:t_028:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We cannot hand power to someone who refuses to accept others.」
